releaseName: Your Freedom Date now uses the payments you actually make
notes: Projections on 0% promotional cards now use the minimum payment you entered while the rate is 0%, instead of a higher post-promo figure from day one. Your Freedom Date may move later; it was optimistic before.
Restoring a backup on a new device no longer replays celebrations for debts you already eliminated.
The Strategy tab no longer freezes while you type a monthly budget, and refreshes several times faster.
